summary.copy_attribution_interpretation: Diagnostic observer only. Upstream Read and downstream Write durations are compared separately with monotonic handler elapsed time. Unix timestamps are retained only for coarse correlation. Inter-read gaps include downstream Write time and bookkeeping and are never added as an independent component. POST observations cover only the 32-byte response copy, not upload request-body handling.
summary.interpretation: Observational diagnostic only; throughput is not qualification evidence and medians do not establish health or causality. Warmup rows explicitly close idle transports. Sequences 9-12 are the first post-close visits to four concrete lane keys; only later same-key visits classify reuse, bound to the prior successful PutIdleConn timestamp and exact origin connection identity.
